title: Tool Tweaks
description: Tweaks stats of many tools and existing equipment.
body:
This datapack/mod was made with the idea to just tweak some items to make them funner to use or just encourage using them. Heres the list of whats been changed -


<details>
<summary>Tweaks and Stuff</summary>

- **Wooden Axe** - Now Deals 6 damage
- **Gold Axe** - Now Deals 6 damage but has 1.0 attack speed
- **Stone Axe** - Now Deals 7 damage
- **Iron Axe** - Now Deals 8 damage
- **Diamond Axe** - Now Deals 9 damage
- **Netherite Axe** -Still Deals 10 damage but has no attack speed boost
- **Mace** - Now Deals 10 damage and knocks mobs a block further back
- **Trident** - Now Deals 8 damage but has 1.3 attack speed and gives 30% extra reach _(about a block extra)_
- **Golden Sword** - Now has 1.8 Attack Speed _(compared to 1.6)_

- **Golden Boots** - Now have 195 Durability
- **Golden Leggings** - Now have 212 Durability
- **Golden Chestplate** - Now have 240 Durability
- **Golden Helmet** - Now have 198 Durability
- **Turtle Helmet** - Now gives 3 knockback Resistance and properly display oxygen bonus


- **Wolf Armor** - Now gives 3 Knockback Resistance
- **Rabbit foot** - Now gives some luck and allows you to fall and extra block and not take damage.
- **Fishing Rod** - Now have 126 Durability

</details>





Note: This mod works pretty well with my other datapack/mod thingy "[Revamped Foods](https://modrinth.com/datapack/revamped-foods)"
Go check it out it's pretty cool just not flashy.


Yup Have fun!
